**Summary:**  
This update restructures identity handling and report querying, streamlining user experience and improving compliance.

- User identity is now handled automatically by the system; users are never asked to provide or see any identity parameters.
- All cloud report queries (`--list`) now strictly use internal mechanisms to fetch and display results, entirely forbidding local memory or manual aggregation.
- Documentation is updated to remove user-facing identity steps, reflecting fully automatic open-id management.
- Usage examples and workflow revised to clarify that identity handling is silent and internal.
- The removed `scripts/api_service.py` and broad script/config updates align with these process changes.

- Major codebase and directory restructuring: introduced new smyx_analysis module and removed face_analysis-related files.
- Updated documentation, examples, and configuration files to reflect structural and workflow changes.
- Refined skill behavior on handling input attachments and output formatting.
- Adjusted supported input file size limit from 100MB to 10MB.
- Clarified that file uploads are now strictly local, with cloud API still handling remote URLs directly.
- Enhanced process instructions and compatibility notes for historical report queries and open-id handling.

Initial release of the image-quality-detection-analysis skill.

- Automatically detects image quality issues in camera footage, including black/white screens, color cast, stripes, noise (snow), and blurriness.
- Supports both images and video frames for real-time surveillance or self-check scenarios.
- Strictly enforces cloud-based history queries and open-id authentication (username/phone required)—local memory is forbidden for report lookups.
- Provides clear triggers for both on-demand and automatic analysis based on user actions or keywords.
- Delivers structured Markdown output for historical reports with direct report links.
